WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE SHIVASHANKAR AMARANNAVAR  ORAL ORDER 1.
This petition is filed by the petitioner seeking transfer of C.C. No. 2721/2021 pending on the file of II Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Davanagere to any Magistrate Court at Bengaluru.
2. Petitioner is the husband and respondent is his wife.

Respondent No.2 filed complaint against the petitioner and case came to be registered in Women Police NC: 2024:KHC:51194 Station,
Davanagere in crime No. 99/2021 for offence under Sections 498A, 504, 323, 114 read with Section 34 of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act (hereinafter for the sake of brevity referred to as the D.P. Act).
Petitioner has been arraigned as accused No. 1 in the said FIR.
Accused Nos. 2 to 5 are other relatives of the petitioner.
After investigation charge sheet came to be filed against petitioner - accused No.1 and accused Nos.2 to 5 who are relatives of the petitioner.

Based on the Praveen Kankanawadi vs The State Of Karnataka on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131835018/
2 charge sheet a case came to be registered against the petitioner in C.C. No. 2721/2021 and it is pending on the file of II Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Davanagere.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for petitioner submits that proceedings in the said criminal case came to be quashed by this Court in Crl.P. No. 7781/2021 by order dated 23.08.2023 insofar as accused Nos. 2 to 5 are concerned.
3. Transfer of the said criminal case is sought on the ground that respondent No. 2 is now working in Bengaluru and so also, the petitioner is working in Bengaluru.

Petitioner had filed a petition under Section 9 NC: 2024:KHC:51194 of the Hindu Marriage Act seeking restitution of conjugal rights on the file of Principal Senior Civil Judge, Gokak in M.C. No. 120/2022.
Respondent No. 2 had sought transfer of the said M.C. No. 120/2022 to the Family Court, Bengaluru, in Civil Petition No. 365/2022.

This Court noting that respondent No. 2 is working and residing in Bengaluru,
transferred said M.C. No. 120/2022 from Court of Principal Senior Civil Judge, Gogak to Family Court, Bengaluru, by order dated 07.03.2024.
Respondent No. 2, inspite of service of notice, did not choose to appear before this Court.

Petitioner has made out grounds for transfer of C.C. No.
2721/2021 pending on the file of II Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Davanagere to Bengaluru.
4.

In the result, the following;
ORDER Petition is allowed.

C.C. No. 2721/2021 pending on the file of II Additional Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Davanagere is ordered to be withdrawn and transferred to the Court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bengaluru Urban NC: 2024:KHC:51194 District, Bengaluru with a direction to assign the same to any other Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bengaluru Urban District,
Bengaluru.
